name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After recital F – Am 20
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: Fa. whereas the Russian Federation has instrumentalised the Ukrainian Orthodox Church, which is historically affiliated with the Russian Orthodox Church, as a vehicle of hybrid influence aimed at undermining the sovereignty of Ukraine, advancing the ‘Russian World’ (Russkiy Mir) ideological doctrine, and seeking to legitimise its aggression in the context of the 2022 full-scale invasion of Ukraine; whereas credible reports and official investigations indicate that certain members of the clergy have been implicated in the dissemination of disinformation, the expression of support for occupation authorities established by the Russian Federation, and engagement in activities incompatible with Ukraine’s national security, sovereignty and territorial integrity; whereas this approach is consistent with the strategic orientation set out in the National Security Strategy of the Russian Federation, approved by President Vladimir Putin on 31 December 2015 and building on the Military Doctrine of 25 December 2014, which explicitly defends so-called ‘traditional Russian spiritual and moral values’ against perceived Western influence, thereby evidencing the instrumentalisation of cultural, religious and value-based narratives for geopolitical purposes1a; whereas this trajectory was further reinforced in the 2021 National Security Strategy, which elevated the protection of such ‘traditional values’, the consolidation of the ‘Russian World’, and the defence of compatriots abroad to the level of core state priorities, framing them as matters of national security and civilisational sovereignty and thus formalising the integration of cultural, religious and informational instruments into state policy and hybrid influence operations1b; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a.
